discovery.summary: Since the 10 Oct 2026 baseline: the EU AI Office published (21 Oct) its view on qualification/independence of external evaluators under the GPAI Code, pointing to the AI Evaluator Forum's AEF-1 standard (drafted as a question, aef1-addition). METR began publishing independent assessments of Anthropic and reviews of its Risk Report; FSI's site was restructured and no longer mentions CAIS.
